revision_note: Pre-delivery source QA: accept multilingual Global Voices author profiles for English articles and exclude explicit republishing/media-partnership statements missed by the initial parser. Reparse the same cached candidate pool; windows, seed, quotas and labels are unchanged. Preliminary v1/v1.1 drafts are preserved for audit and are not the delivered dataset.
selection: Round-robin across calendar months, within each month ascending SHA256(seed|window_id|publisher|canonical_url). No detector scores or event keywords used. Keep shortages visible.
label_policy: All new records remain unassigned, pending and labels:null. A calendar-control sampling stratum is not a verified peaceful period or negative label.
scope_policy: Country/region queries retrieve a broad candidate pool; case relevance remains unverified. Domestic, cultural and military stories are not removed based on event type.
reuse_policy: Save English text only from openly licensed Global Voices stories or VOA original reporting. Exclude identified wire/partner republications and non-text media from usable full-text samples. Preserve links, authors, license, retrieval time and content hashes.
freeze_policy: Do not modify the fixed 60 review articles, existing data splits or frozen model. New data need human review and story/case/time grouping before any future fit.
